name: 20562-longprefill-06blora-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B, already in the local HF cache.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1. One GPU, one server, no router and no external cache tier.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 3000 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix, every prompt exactly 6144 tokens and every response exactly 8. Radix cache is off, so every request is a real 6144-token prefill.
purpose: A document classification service applying a small model to 6,000-token documents with 32 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# `sglang serve` CLI form. Flat keys only -- an indented block is skipped line by line and
# the engine then starts without what this file declares.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B
tp-size: 1

# The adapter is selected per request by the `lora_path` body field, not by the model name.
enable-lora: true
lora-paths: ["lora=codelion/Qwen3-0.6B-accuracy-recovery-lora"]
max-lora-rank: 64
lora-backend: torch_native

disable-radix-cache: true
